messages.subject: tags$head() empty
parts:
In the R session below, I compare the output of tags$head() with tags$style(). tags$style() displays "<style></style>" as expected. But tags$head() does not display "<head></head>". What am I doing wrong?

> tags$head()
 
> tags$style()
<style></style> 
>

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: tags$head() empty
parts:
You were not doing anything worng. It is a matter of printing. I guess
the printing function in shiny/htmltools was designed to print the
HTML body. The HTML head is extracted and rendered separately when an
HTML page is to be rendered, because we normally only see the HTML
body. This does not mean tags$head() is essentially different with
tags$style(): both are essentially lists, and it is just their printed
representations that are different. If you are interested in playing
with the HTML head, you can take a look at htmltools::renderTags.

Regards,
Yihui
